{{Top|leg}}
A '''detail''' was a military unit used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Smaller than a [[Squad/Legends|squad]], a detail consisted of between three and five stormtroopers. When the Empire took over [[Research Station Shantipole]] in the [[Roche asteroid field]], [[District Commander]] [[Bane Nothos]] ordered details and squads of stormtroopers to patrol the facility and detain any [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] present.<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref>
